{{Infobox auto}}

'''Honey ginger tea''' is the simple preparation of [[Honey|honey]]. It heals {{Hp|2}}, grants {{EffectLink|Speed}} for 30 seconds and removes harmful effects.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/honey_ginger_tea.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A honey bottle heats into honey ginger tea in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Drinking honey ginger tea takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|2}}, gives Speed I (+20% speed) for 0:30 and removes the same maleffects as [[bread]]. It gives the glass bottle back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_37.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
